features.title: All the market insight, in real time
features.intro: Four moves, from the first on-chain event to the alert.

observe.title: Observe
observe.body: Track pools, liquidity changes and market activity across Meteora, in real time.

reconstruct.title: Reconstruct
reconstruct.body: Rebuild liquidity history and replay movements, hour by hour.

analyze.title: Analyze
analyze.body: Detect anomalies and patterns, and surface the signals that matter.

signal.title: Signal
signal.body: Get real-time alerts on key events, spikes and liquidity imbalances.

steps.title: From the chain to the screen
steps.intro: A dedicated decoder per protocol, starting with Meteora. The history builds up over time.

listen.title: Listen
listen.body: A permanent stream from a Solana node captures Meteora's events as soon as they are emitted.

decode.title: Decode
decode.body: Each event is decoded: swaps, liquidity, fees, positions, locks.

enrich.title: Enrich
enrich.body: Token metadata and USD prices are added to each event.

store.title: Store
store.body: Everything lands in a queryable time-series database.

expose.title: Expose
expose.body: A typed HTTP API and a public dashboard, in English and French.

cta.title: Ready to see everything?
cta.subtitle: The dashboard is public and free. Open it and watch Meteora's liquidity move.
